official_definition: Furious Charge - (When Attacks) You can target attack one opposing Spirit/Ultimate. At the end of a blocked battle, for each Symbol on this Spirit, send one opposing Life to the Reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Furious Charge] or [Furious Charge: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Furious Charge]", "give [Furious Charge]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
